BiblicalUsage: En-Charod is a place in Palestine. The name appears in Judges (Judges 7:1). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Charod matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Charod is one of them.
